method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: A slab clock against an empty gradient sky; no ground, beam or rimrock.
notes.fix: Under the covered walkway so the clock hangs from a modelled edge beam, the rimrock and a clouded sky behind, the walk with its shade band at the foot.

notes.problem: A clock on a plain slab with a painted shadow; the sector reads as a sticker; a sky band; no ground.
notes.fix: Pull back to show the walkway, a bus flank and the rimrock; a real shadow on a chamfered surround; the sector lit with an emissive.

notes.problem: A clock on a slab against empty sky; no ground, horizon, Fort Davis or bus.
notes.fix: Pull back so the clock hangs from the walkway's edge beam over concrete, the rimrock and grama on the lower third and a bus flank at the right edge.

notes.problem: Helmet-haired mannequins on a blank plane fading to fog; no campus; no shade band.
notes.fix: Camera behind the walkway's shade band at 1.6 m; extend the campus to the horizon; fabric and hair on the walkers.

notes.problem: Mannequins on an empty plain fading to fog; no shade band.
notes.fix: Camera under the walkway deck with its shadow across the foreground; walkers at half size in the sun beyond; a wing and kerb across the back.

notes.problem: Helmet-haired mannequins on a featureless apron; an off-frame shadow; no shade band.
notes.fix: Camera under the covered walk with its shade band across the foreground; walkers smaller and turned away; grit and joints on the walk.

notes.problem: A bar chart before a blurred wall; the solid 10% box reads as a present value.
notes.fix: The 10% before column as a ghost glass column; a raking window light across the oak.

notes.problem: Primitive boxes; the glass column vanishes; the foreground washed grey.
notes.fix: A lit frosted edge and stone caps on the glass; a window sun patch across the table; a darker near edge.

notes.problem: Blocks on a shelf before a blank wall; the 10 block reads as current; a smudge in the glass base.
notes.fix: The long oak table with a raking window; labels on the block and the empty footprint; remove the smudge.

notes.problem: A mannequin parent on the gutter line; the arm folded flat; a flat sky.
notes.fix: Swing the arm out; the parent on the kerb with a contact shadow; an oak's shade pool on the sidewalk.

notes.problem: Glossy plastic bus with a fender blade; the arm flush; the parent in the road.
notes.fix: Rougher paint with dust; fix the fender; swing the arm out; the parent on the kerb in the oak's shadow.

notes.problem: A mannequin parent on the asphalt in profile; the bus reads as a toy.
notes.fix: The parent on the kerb, turned away, with a shadow; the oak's shade across the kerb.

notes.problem: 70 percent flat wall; the seal a dark hole; a grey slab on the left; the ten chairs one black mass.
notes.fix: A three quarter view from the aisle end with 1.2 m between chairs, a raking window patch on the wall, and the kit seal_plaque in bronze.

notes.problem: A dark disc that reads as a hole; a grey slab on the left.
notes.fix: A lit carved seal with a cast shadow; crop the slab; rake window light across the wall.

notes.problem: The bus flank in muddy shade reads brown; low-poly cars; an empty sky.
notes.fix: Light the east flank full; higher-detail vehicles or crop them out.

notes.problem: An ochre bus with flat windows; low-poly cars; the foot washed grey.
notes.fix: Turn the bus so its flank takes the key; window interiors; darker near asphalt in place of the wash.

notes.problem: Cross-hatched procedural oak; the sheet flat with no readable contact; a featureless wall.
notes.fix: Straight-grain veneer; a 6 mm curl casting a crescent shadow; a bright window frame behind the sheet.
